objective: Materialise 150 genuinely new Stage-300 cases whose source packs and genuine CaseBrain production captures supply exact named inputs from the 43-control unlock path. Not an adapter-foundation batch. Do not freeze or run Stage 300.
namedPrerequisiteDefinition: A case is named-prerequisite-complete for a control only when the exact missing input listed in the unlock-path register is present on a genuine production capture channel or an authorised harness capture artefact that the control's evaluator/adapter reads — never because the truth key contains the fact, never because schema-valid representation alone exists, and never because a field was copied from the truth key into CaseBrain output.

eligibilityMeaning.corpusDesignSatisfied: Source pack contains the exact facts/documents/binaries the control needs (inventory only).
eligibilityMeaning.productionOrHarnessNamedComplete: CaseBrain production output or authorised harness receipt actually carries the structured named prerequisite.
eligibilityMeaning.readyForStage300Calibration: productionOrHarnessNamedComplete === true AND independenceClass !== TAUTOLOGICAL_UNSAFE AND detector/evaluator exists or is scheduled — still not a PASS or promotion.
notEligibleIf: Source has the fact but CaseBrain/harness did not emit/capture the structured prerequisite
Metadata-only exit counted as genuine exit

exactControlsTargeted.P1: all remaining 29 essential controls from the unlock-path register (AUD/XPP/VDR/ELD remainder)

rejectionConditions: Duplicate caseId or source/packet fingerprint collision
Near-duplicate beyond disclosed template lineage without meaningful fact variation
Truth key opened during CaseBrain output generation
CaseBrain output field populated from truth key
Specialty/OCR/audience/ELD bag invented into CaseBrain output without production/harness producer
Missing any of the six genuine production exits
Frozen Stage-150 membership or packet hashes mutated
Truth phrases embedded in production code
permittedOutcomes: accepted case with genuine exits + hashed artefacts
productionOrHarnessNamedComplete true for SRC/VDR (and others only if genuinely emitted)
explicit defer where cohort cannot supply without live product work
whatCompletionDoesProve: 150 unique new Stage-300 identities exist with source+truth frozen separately from production capture
Genuine production builders produced six non-browser exits where available
Per-control denominator report against the 43-control unlock path
Honest production-vs-harness-vs-corpus ownership for every miss
Blinding order observed; no audit verdicts run
whatCompletionDoesNotProve: That specialty bags exist on production if they do not
That AUD/XPP/ELD are eligible if production does not emit required packs
